p4-radix-items-rows.description: P4 class R: the recorded RadixRun payload layout items rows is printed as the explicit default layout argument RadixRun<_, _, ::std::vec::Vec<_>> (identical Rust type to RadixRun<_, _>)

p4-packed-canon.description: P4 class P: authored canon(packed) advice records dedup::Packed for canonical rows records (EXT-PackedCanon, PL-PackedCanon); same answers and order, different build work, measured by paired timing

closed-capture-binding.description: Closed capture (A-Capture, A-CaptureRef, IF-Capture): a query-closed let/if/head operand is hoisted at CQ normalization into a host-once capture bound as `let __cq_capture_N: T = e; let p = &__cq_capture_N;` and read as Clone::clone(p); the constant column leaves row tuples, so the empty-key (key ()) HashIndex/SortedRun build, its seek(&())/lookup(&()) driver and the index-driven task tiling disappear and the remaining scan drives the plan; same answers, different build work, measured by paired timing

closed-capture-renumber.description: Closed capture renumbering only: the hoisted capture shifts generated parameter/relation/task-driver ordinals (__cq_parameter_N, __cq_rN_*, __cq_task_driver_N, __cq_generated_N); token streams equal modulo these ordinals
